description.zh:
RAM用户登录名称。
不指定表示获取当前调用身份下的服务凭证。
description.en:
The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
If not specified, the service credential of the identity that invokes the current operation is retrieved.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims get-service-credential --service-credential-id SC0000000000000000 --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --region cn-hangzhou
